name: HoverCard
description: Radix HoverCard. Opens on hover with a delay. Unlike a tooltip it may contain layout and images — but like a tooltip it is unreachable on touch.
intent: A rich preview of what a link points to, without making the user go there.

props.name: align
props.hint: Accepted by this component and passed to the underlying primitive. Named in the component signature, so it is part of this surface.

props.hint: Accepted by this component and passed to the underlying primitive. Named in the component signature, so it is part of this surface.

props.name: className
props.hint: Merged with the component classes via cn(). Use for layout only — never to override a variant that already exists.

keyboard: Focus on the trigger opens it
requiredAttributes: A meaningful accessible name on the trigger
notes: Hover-only by design. Always duplicate anything important somewhere reachable.
Do not place primary actions inside — they are unreachable on touch.

usage: User or entity previews on a mention
Link previews with a thumbnail and summary
Supplementary context that is genuinely optional
doNotUse: Anything required to complete the task — touch users will never see it
Content the user must interact with — use ui:popover

agentRules: Preview only. Never the sole source of anything.
